patch.summary: AWeber cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: AWeber pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: AWeber plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: AWeber cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price AWeber against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Creators and solopreneurs needing email + landing pages + basic funnels requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps
Side-by-side cost with GetResponse on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Lite caps lists, LPs, automations, users, and segments vs Plus

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Marketing pricing page emphasizes Lite/Plus/Done For You; Unlimited details live primarily in docs

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Promo setup fees and 'months free' offers are time-limited — verify live checkout

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Less suited to complex B2B multi-product marketing automation / CRM-heavy stacks

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs AWeber on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model email-marketing spend with AWeber in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for AWeber alongside category cost modelling.
